proposals.title: Directional muzzle flash petals
proposals.change: Add a three-petal additive muzzle flash burst with a forward-biased silhouette and 0.04 second lifetime.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a very small cone-aligned proxy at the weapon bore, warm white center with restrained amber edges, one burst per shot, no opaque smoke geometry.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Additive-only, sub-frame flash confined to the weapon bore and below the L55 silhouette envelope.
proposals.acceptance_test: PropNose and ADS remain Usable with a readable flash shape and no persistent dark pixels after the burst.

proposals.title: Muzzle flash radial pulse
proposals.change: Add a thin radial emissive pulse at the muzzle immediately after the primary flash.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a 0.02 second expanding ring with low opacity, limited to the weapon silhouette, and disable bloom-heavy scaling.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive ring has no opaque coverage and does not alter background luminance.
proposals.acceptance_test: The ring reads as a single shot accent in ADS without washing out nearby geometry or creating a visible wall.

proposals.title: Thin gun smoke filament
proposals.change: Add one narrow dissipating smoke filament trailing upward from the weapon after firing.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use pale gray additive particles at very low opacity, three particles maximum, 0.35 second lifetime, and no camera-facing wall sprites.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The effect is thin, translucent, and localized to the firing point; it cannot form a dark FOV wall.
proposals.acceptance_test: Smoke remains a narrow filament in both cameras and clears before the next capture frame.

proposals.title: Gun smoke curl breakup
proposals.change: Replace the final gun-smoke particle with two small upward-curling wisps that separate before fading.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use two low-alpha ribbons, 0.22 second lifetime, soft gray-blue tint, and a strict maximum screen-space width.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive wisps break up the shell without introducing opaque smoke coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: No camera shows a dark smoke patch, and the wisps remain inside the weapon-adjacent silhouette.

proposals.title: Hit spark needle burst
proposals.change: Add a six-particle needle-shaped hit spark burst at confirmed impact points.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use short radial needles with warm-white cores, amber tips, 0.08 second lifetime, and bounded particle count.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only emissive needle geometry is added at local impact points; no dark or opaque coverage is introduced.
proposals.acceptance_test: Impacts read clearly at capture resolution while the surrounding material values remain unchanged.

proposals.title: Ricochet spark streak
proposals.change: Add one short directional ricochet streak leaving each metallic impact point.
proposals.implementation_notes: Orient the streak along the impact normal, use a 0.06 second lifetime, and clamp length to a few pixels in the final capture.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single tiny additive streak improves impact readability without affecting broad regions of either camera.
proposals.acceptance_test: The streak is visible only at impact locations and does not become a continuous line or screen-space artifact.

proposals.title: Drone explosion hot core
proposals.change: Add a compact additive hot-core flash inside the drone explosion volume.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use one small spherical proxy with a white-to-orange gradient, 0.12 second lifetime, and no opaque shell.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The proxy is additive, compact, and isolated to the existing drone event location.
proposals.acceptance_test: The explosion gains a readable center without blooming over adjacent aircraft edges or sky.

proposals.title: Drone explosion shock ring
proposals.change: Add a thin expanding emissive shock ring around the drone explosion core.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single camera-facing ring with 0.16 second lifetime, low opacity, and a strict maximum radius tied to the drone bounds.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The ring remains inside a small event footprint and contributes no opaque or dark material.
proposals.acceptance_test: Wide and Combat retain clear sky separation with a readable ring that fades before becoming a broad halo.

proposals.title: Flak pinprick cluster
proposals.change: Add three separated additive flak pinpricks around the existing burst center.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use tiny warm-white points with nonuniform spacing, 0.1 second lifetime, and no smoke sprite layer.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Separated points preserve city and sky visibility while adding high-frequency event detail.
proposals.acceptance_test: City and Wide show distinct flak points without a connected dark mass or sky washout.

proposals.title: Flak micro-ring accent
proposals.change: Add a narrow low-alpha ring immediately around the flak burst center.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the ring radius below the existing burst bounds, use 0.08 second lifetime, and tint it neutral warm gray rather than saturated orange.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The thin additive ring is local to the burst and does not obscure buildings, aircraft, or sky.
proposals.acceptance_test: The ring improves burst shape recognition without changing the broad luminance distribution of either camera.

proposals.title: Prop wash edge ribbons
proposals.change: Add two narrow additive ribbons along the outer edges of the prop wash volume.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use pale blue-white translucent ribbons with low opacity, 0.28 second lifetime, and placement outside the cockpit and fuselage centerline.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Ribbons are additive, thin, and placed at the existing effect boundary rather than across the aircraft body.
proposals.acceptance_test: Prop and YakBeauty retain readable aircraft contours with a subtle directional wash cue.

proposals.title: Prop wash vortex dots
proposals.change: Add four small rotating emissive markers to suggest the prop wash vortex without adding opaque dust.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use four low-intensity dots arranged in a shallow arc, 0.18 second lifetime, with rotation constrained to the local propeller plane.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Tiny emissive markers add motion structure while leaving the prop hub and aircraft shading unobstructed.
proposals.acceptance_test: Markers remain individually separated and do not merge into a bright disc in either camera.

proposals.title: Tracer segmented streak
proposals.change: Add a two-segment additive tracer streak with a deliberate gap between lead and tail.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use two short segments aligned to projectile travel, 0.11 second lifetime, with the tail at half intensity and no continuous beam.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The tracer is narrow and additive, with bounded length that cannot form a bright FOV band.
proposals.acceptance_test: Combat and ADS show projectile direction clearly without clipping across unrelated geometry.

proposals.title: Tracer launch spark
proposals.change: Add a single small launch spark at the tracer origin before the streak appears.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use one pin-sized flash with 0.035 second lifetime, warm-white center, and strict origin anchoring to the emitter.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single origin-local additive point has negligible screen coverage and no material replacement.
proposals.acceptance_test: The launch cue is visible at the emitter without producing a persistent bright dot in later frames.

proposals.title: Ocean spray bead chain
proposals.change: Add a short chain of four bright spray beads along the crest of the existing ocean impact.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use tiny pale-blue additive spheres with varied height, 0.2 second lifetime, and no broad spray fan geometry.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Beads are sparse, small, and additive, preserving the L55 ocean silhouette and avoiding a duplicated broad fan.
proposals.acceptance_test: Ocean and Harbor gain readable water breakup without a continuous bright strip or dark patch.

proposals.title: Water splash crown tips
proposals.change: Add five tiny additive crown tips at the outer edge of a water splash impact.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a low-opacity pale foam tint, 0.14 second lifetime, and keep all tips inside the existing splash footprint.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only small additive tips are introduced, with no change to ocean materials or large silhouette coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: Splash edges become legible at capture resolution while horizon and water values remain stable.

proposals.title: Missile trail knot accents
proposals.change: Add two separated hot knots along the missile trail at fixed intervals.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use small orange-white additive knots with 0.12 second lifetime and low intensity, excluding any opaque smoke volume.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Knots are sparse emissive accents along an existing line and cannot create a dark trail wall.
proposals.acceptance_test: The trail reads as directional and continuous without becoming a bright diagonal across the full frame.

proposals.title: Behind-wall missile trail breakup
proposals.change: Place three tiny pale trail breakup puffs behind the primary wall boundary to add depth to the missile path.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep all geometry at x>=bx+3, use small unlit pale-blue sprites with short lifetimes, and omit dark smoke coloration.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Hero-authored geometry is explicitly behind the wall boundary and uses pale unlit values rather than dark smoke.
proposals.acceptance_test: Depth breakup is visible only in the intended background region and leaves foreground silhouettes unchanged.

proposals.title: Explosion falling spark flecks
proposals.change: Add three short-lived non-ember white-orange flecks descending from the drone explosion edge.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use angular debris-like flecks rather than round embers, 0.13 second lifetime, low count, and strict local bounds around the explosion.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The flecks are sparse additive particles and are distinct from the existing ember accent.
proposals.acceptance_test: Flecks add a downward breakup cue without becoming a repeated ember field or affecting harbor readability.

proposals.title: Localized flak impact glint
proposals.change: Add one thin emissive glint line at the nearest flak impact edge to sharpen the burst silhouette.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single sub-burst line aligned to the local impact normal, 0.05 second lifetime, and cap length below the existing flak radius.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single tiny additive line provides local edge definition without changing city or prop-hub materials.
proposals.acceptance_test: The nearest flak event gains one readable edge highlight while all 11 cameras remain Usable.
